title: Hash-chained audit and verify command
epic: E0.4 Event log and audit chain
description: Chain each event to the hash of the previous one and add fw audit verify that walks the chain and reports the first broken link.
acceptance: Flipping one byte in a stored payload makes verify fail naming the sequence number
Verify of 100k events completes in under 8 s
Chain head can be exported for external anchoring
core_adaptation: One chain only: the events table. There is no separate audit process in Core.
